prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Show, Hide, and Move Your Pet", "Click your desktop tray icon anytime to toggle pet visibility or right-click for quick settings.", "Desktop Control Tip"]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is registered and saved to your account.", "Account Saved Companion"]
2: ["Sign in with your existing account to instantly restore your saved pets and progress."]
3: ["Rendering 3D animations... Preparing tray integration... Finalizing companion personality..."]
4: ["Choose Your Companion Experience", "Select whether you want a quick starter pet or a fully customized companion.", "Takes less than 1 minute to start"]
5: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is active on your desktop. Use the system tray icon to control, talk to, or hide your companion anytime."]
6: ["All companion paths save automatically to your signed-in account."]
7: ["Confirm Companion Customization", "Your custom pet details have been processed successfully.", "Ready for Adoption"]
8: ["Sign In to Access Your Saved Pets", "Sign in to keep your desktop pet synced across devices and restore past adoptions."]
9: ["Feel free to minimize the window. We will notify you when your pet is ready on your desktop."]
